cases.question: average speed per vessel
cases.sql: SELECT vessel, avg(speed) AS avg_speed FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: how many readings per vessel
cases.sql: SELECT vessel, count(*) AS count FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: what was the highest wave height
cases.sql: SELECT MAX(wave_height) FROM telemetry

cases.question: average water temperature across the fleet
cases.sql:
-- view: line
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS t, AVG(water_temp) AS avg_temp FROM telemetry GROUP BY t ORDER BY t

cases.question: minimum and maximum speed for each vessel
cases.sql: SELECT vessel, MIN(speed) AS min_speed, MAX(speed) AS max_speed FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: hourly average wind speed over the last 2 days
cases.sql:
-- view: line
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hour, avg(wind) AS avg_wind FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '2 days' GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour

cases.question: max wave height per vessel per day
cases.sql: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 day', ts) AS day, vessel, MAX(wave_height) AS max_wave FROM telemetry GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

cases.question: daily minimum and maximum water temperature
cases.sql:
-- view: bar
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 day', ts) AS day, MIN(water_temp) AS min_temp, MAX(water_temp) AS max_temp FROM telemetry GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

cases.question: Aurora's average speed in 15-minute buckets over the last day
cases.sql:
-- view: line
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '15 minutes', ts) AS t, avg(speed) AS avg_speed FROM telemetry WHERE vessel = 'Aurora' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '1 day' GROUP BY t ORDER BY t

cases.question: average wind per vessel in six-hour buckets
cases.sql:
-- view: bar
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '6 hours', ts) AS bucket, vessel, avg(wind) AS avg_wind FROM telemetry GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

cases.question: average speed by hour of day
cases.sql:
-- view: bar
SELECT extract(hour FROM ts) AS hour, avg(speed) AS avg_speed FROM telemetry GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

cases.question: average wave height by day of the week
cases.sql:
-- view: bar
SELECT dayname(ts) AS day, avg(wave_height) AS avg_wave FROM telemetry GROUP BY day ORDER BY dayofweek(min(ts))

cases.question: speed of Atlas every 10 minutes today
cases.sql:
-- view: line
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '10 minutes', ts) AS t, avg(speed) AS avg_speed FROM telemetry WHERE vessel = 'Atlas' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 00:00:00' GROUP BY t ORDER BY t

cases.question: water temperature trend for Aurora in the last week
cases.sql:
-- view: line
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '6 hours', ts) AS t, AVG(water_temp) AS avg_temp FROM telemetry WHERE vessel = 'Aurora' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY t ORDER BY t

cases.question: which vessel was fastest on average in the last 24 hours
cases.sql:
-- view: bar
SELECT vessel, avg(speed) AS avg_speed FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '24 hours' GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY avg_speed DESC LIMIT 6

cases.question: compare wave height of all vessels by hour over the last 12 hours
cases.sql:
-- view: line
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS t, vessel, avg(wave_height) AS avg_wave FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '12 hours' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

cases.question: mean speed for the last 30 minutes in one-minute buckets
cases.sql: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 minute', ts) AS t, avg(speed) AS avg_speed FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '30 minutes' GROUP BY t ORDER BY t

cases.question: Average wind from September 3 to September 5, 2026, hourly
cases.sql:
-- view: line
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hour, AVG(wind) AS avg_wind FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= '2026-09-03 00:00:00' AND ts < '2026-09-06 00:00:00' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

cases.question: Average wave height for the last hour in one-minute buckets
cases.sql:
-- view: line
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 minute', ts) AS t, AVG(wave_height) AS avg_wave FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '1 hour' GROUP BY t ORDER BY t

cases.question: compare speed of Kestrel and Nomad by hour
cases.sql:
-- view: line
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hour, vessel, avg(speed) AS avg_speed FROM telemetry WHERE vessel IN ('Kestrel', 'Nomad') GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

cases.question: Compare vessel speed by hour over the last day excluding Aurora
cases.sql:
-- view: line
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hour, vessel, avg(speed) AS avg_speed FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '1 day' AND vessel != 'Aurora' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

cases.question: how many readings had waves above 4 metres, per vessel
cases.sql:
-- view: bar
SELECT vessel, count(*) AS count FROM telemetry WHERE wave_height > 4 GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: Hourly average speed for vessels north of latitude 50 in the last day
cases.sql:
-- view: line
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS t, vessel, avg(speed) AS avg_speed FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '1 day' AND lat > 50 GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

cases.question: Show hourly wind for Poseidon over the last 7 days
cases.sql:
-- view: line
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS t, avg(wind) AS avg_wind FROM telemetry WHERE vessel = 'Poseidon' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY t ORDER BY t

cases.question: in how many hours did Solstice see wind above 30 knots
cases.sql: SELECT count(*)/600.0 as hours FROM telemetry WHERE vessel = 'Solstice' AND wind > 30

cases.question: table of the 10 highest hourly average wave heights
cases.sql:
-- view: table
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hour, AVG(wave_height) AS avg_wave FROM telemetry GROUP BY hour ORDER BY avg_wave DESC LIMIT 10

cases.question: the three fastest vessels by average speed in the past 7 days
cases.sql:
-- view: bar
SELECT vessel, avg(speed) AS avg_speed FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY avg_speed DESC LIMIT 3

cases.question: which day had the strongest average wind
cases.sql:
-- view: bar
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 day', ts) AS day, AVG(wind) AS avg_wind FROM telemetry GROUP BY day ORDER BY avg_wind DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: which vessel recorded the coldest water
cases.sql: SELECT vessel, MIN(water_temp) AS min_temp FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY min_temp ASC LIMIT 1

cases.question: which vessel got farthest east
cases.sql: SELECT vessel, MAX(lon) AS max_lon FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY max_lon DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: correlation between wind and speed per vessel
cases.sql:
-- view: scatter
SELECT vessel, corr(wind, speed) AS correlation FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: difference between maximum and minimum water temperature per vessel
cases.sql: SELECT vessel, max(water_temp) - min(water_temp) AS temp_diff FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: Compare speed and wave height by hour over the last 7 days
cases.sql:
-- view: line
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hour, AVG(speed) AS avg_speed, AVG(wave_height) AS avg_wave FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

cases.question: Average ratio of wave height to wind speed per hour over the last day
cases.sql:
-- view: line
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS t, AVG(wave_height / wind) AS ratio FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '1 day' GROUP BY t ORDER BY t

cases.question: average speed of each vessel in km/h over the last day
cases.sql: SELECT vessel, avg(speed * 1.852) AS avg_speed_kmh FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '1 day' GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: average speed per vessel in the first week versus the second week
cases.sql:
-- view: bar
SELECT CASE WHEN ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-09-08 00:00:00' THEN 'Week 1' ELSE 'Week 2' END AS period, vessel, avg(speed) AS avg_speed FROM telemetry GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

cases.question: latest position of every vessel
cases.sql:
-- view: map
SELECT vessel, lat, lon FROM telemetry WHERE ts = (SELECT MAX(ts) FROM telemetry) ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: where was Meridian yesterday
cases.sql:
-- view: map
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS t, lat, lon FROM telemetry WHERE vessel = 'Meridian' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-13 00:00:00' AND ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 00:00:00' ORDER BY t

cases.question: show all vessel tracks on a map
cases.sql:
-- view: map
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS t, vessel, avg(lat) AS lat, avg(lon) AS lon FROM telemetry GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

cases.question: how many readings were taken north of 50 degrees latitude, per vessel
cases.sql: SELECT vessel,count(*) as count FROM telemetry WHERE lat > 50 GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: Aurora's average position per day
cases.sql:
-- view: map
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 day', ts) AS day, avg(lat) AS lat, avg(lon) AS lon FROM telemetry WHERE vessel = 'Aurora' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

cases.question: average wave height per ves
cases.sql: SELECT vessel, avg(wave_height) as avg_wave FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: wind
cases.sql:
-- view: line
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS t, vessel, avg(wind) AS avg_wind FROM telemetry GROUP BY t, vessel ORDER BY t, vessel

cases.question: speed last week
cases.sql:
-- view: line
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS t, AVG(speed) AS avg_speed FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY t ORDER BY t

cases.question: scatter of wind vs wave height
cases.sql:
-- view: scatter
SELECT wind, wave_height FROM telemetry ORDER BY wind, wave_height LIMIT 5000
